scripts.build: npm --workspace apt-client run build && npm run build:copy && npm --workspace apt-worker run build
scripts.build:copy: if [ -z "$(ls -A apt-client/dist 2>/dev/null)" ]; then echo 'ERROR: apt-client/dist is empty or missing — run npm --workspace apt-client run build first' >&2; exit 1; fi && rm -rf apt-worker/dist && mkdir -p apt-worker/dist && cp -r apt-client/dist/. apt-worker/dist/
scripts.typecheck: npm --workspace apt-worker run typecheck && npm --workspace apt-client run typecheck
